name: lgr-studio
description: LGR Studio - Interface responsiva em Electron e navegador para os 7 passos clássicos do Lugar Geométrico das Raízes

scripts.mobile:open: npm run mobile:sync && cap open android
scripts.mobile:apk: npm run mobile:sync && node scripts/run-gradle.js assembleDebug
scripts.package:linux: node scripts/assert-platform.js linux && npm run package:python && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --linux AppImage deb
scripts.package:windows: node scripts/assert-platform.js win32 && npm run package:python && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis portable
scripts.test: npm run test:js && npm run test:python
scripts.test:js: node --check scripts/start-electron.js && node --check scripts/run-python.js && node --check scripts/sync-mobile.js && node --check scripts/run-gradle.js && node --check scripts/install-apk.js && node --check scripts/build-python.js && node --check scripts/assert-platform.js && node --check scripts/validate-packaging.js && node --check electron-builder.config.cjs && node --check src/main/main.js && node --check src/preload/preload.js && node --check src/renderer/app.js && node --check src/renderer/web-api.js && node --check src/renderer/sw.js && node scripts/validate-packaging.js

author: Enthony Araujo
